ai_summary: The Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 27, 2026, at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan, Banten, Indonesia. research_highlights: The event offers multiple distance categories: 5K, 8K Obstacle Run, 10K, Half Marathon (21K), and a Kids Obstacle category, all starting and finishing at Uptown Park, Summarecon Mall Serpong.

Cut-off times reported for the prior (2025) edition were roughly 1 hour for the 5K, 1h45 for the 10K, 2 hours for the 8K Obstacle Run, and 3h15 for the Half Marathon, with staggered early-morning starts between 05:15 and 06:00 WIB.
The Half Marathon route is described as World Athletics Certified, aimed at runners chasing a personal best.
The 8K Obstacle category includes multiple built obstacles such as a monkey bar, balance beams over a mud pool, a rope track, and a winding maze with an artificial rain effect near the finish.
October in the Jakarta/Serpong area is typically the start of the rainy season, so participants can expect cooler conditions and a chance of light rain rather than extreme heat.
research_watchouts: No refunds are given except where legally required, and event dates, times, or locations can be changed by the organizer at any time.
Only Indonesian citizens and foreigners holding a KITAS are eligible for podium placings or prize money; other foreign participants run non-competitively.

As of the sources found, there is little independent participant race-report detail (e.g., on course crowding, water stations, or heat issues) beyond organizer-sponsored recaps and promotional community write-ups.
